title: perf(ui-scripts): share one scan memo across the live-tree walker test's three verdicts
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbJaNVeER9S4KLS3jR37aFwg)_

Fixes #31941

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:选择器 `selectAffectedTests` 多了一个可选输入 `scans`(由新导出的 `scanMemo(root, walker)` 生成),同一棵未改动的树上连问几次时,每个文件的 import 扫描只读一遍;活树「路径遍历器」测试的三次调用共用它。
- **为什么改**:该测试三次调用各自把所有测试文件的 import 闭包重读一遍,PR CI 上 12.1 s(上限 15 s),合并队列里两次超时(15.9 s、15.4 s),把 PR #31936 踢出队列。
- **风险与回滚**:不传 `scans` 时行为逐字节不变,命令行不传;传错根或遍历器时选择器直接拒绝。新增的夹具测试证明有无共享、正反两种填充顺序下每个裁决都相同。全局 `testTimeout` 不动。回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看**:`ui/scripts/select-affected-tests.mjs`(`closureSummaries` 的 `memo` 命中分支、`scanMemo`、`selectAffectedTests` 开头的拒绝)、`ui/scripts/__tests__/select-affected-tests.test.ts`(路径遍历器测试与新 describe「a shared scan memo」)。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/select-affected-tests.test.ts --reporter=verbose`,预期 70 个用例全绿,路径遍历器测试约 4 s(原来约 9 s)。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **Measured first** (local, objectstack `e0c2720c`): the walker test took 8.9 s. Each of its three `selectAffectedTests` calls took 2.5–3.0 s. Of one call (`--cpu-prof`, 2.9 s), `closureSummaries` was 2.3 s: reading every placed test's import closure (`readFileSync`, `moduleSpecifiers`, `resolveRelative`, `libraryReadsDisk`, `readRadius`). `git ls-files` was 15 ms and `listWorkspacePackages` 4 ms, so passing the existing `tracked` input saves nothing (measured: 2.4–2.9 s per call either way). The three calls repeat the same scan: the walker and selector calls place the same test files, and the empty change places a superset.
- **Option (a), a memo of the scan.** `closureSummaries` takes an optional `memo` (a `Map` from file to its scanned node). A file it already holds is not read again; its edges are queued as before. `selectAffectedTests` takes an optional `scans` (made by the new export `scanMemo(root, walker)`) and passes its map down. A node depends on the tree and the walker, never on the change, so it is valid while no file under `root` changes. The selector throws on a memo made for another root or walker. The command line never makes one, so CI's selection path is unchanged.
- **The walker test** makes one `scanMemo()` and passes it to its three calls. Its assertions are unchanged. A one-line comment names this card and the measured times.
- **No timeout was raised**, neither the global `testTimeout` nor a per-test one.

## Tests

- New `describe('select-affected-tests — a shared scan memo (objectstack#31941)')` on the fixture workspace:
  - Six changes (docs-only, `scripts/`, `@fx/a`, `@fx/c`, `@fx/registry`, the walker file as `outside`) give the same verdict with a shared memo as without one, filled in both orders. The memo ends non-empty.
  - A memo made for another root, or for no walker, is refused.
- **Times** (`--reporter=verbose`, this container):

  | test | before | after |
  |:--|--:|--:|
  | walker test (the card's subject) | 8876 ms | 4182 ms |
  | agrees with turbo | 533 ms | 463 ms |
  | dom-heavy project | 20 ms | 15 ms |
  | root config reach | 23 ms | 22 ms |
  | invoked-as.mjs pins | 1 ms | 1 ms |
  | command line verdict | 3312 ms | 3195 ms |
  | could not decide | 62 ms | 58 ms |

  On PR CI the walker test read 12127 ms (run 42620148110, job 129171167460), 1.37x this container. At that ratio it reads about 5.7 s, under half of its 15 s budget.
- The whole file: `Tests 70 passed (70)`.
- Outside the test, the same three verdicts (`node`, scratch script): 8.3 s alone, 4.7 s shared (2.8 + 0.8 + 1.0 s), and `JSON.stringify` of each shared verdict equals the unshared one, in both orders.
- **Ablation** (`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor: the line that queues a cached node's edges, deleted): the new "changes no verdict" case went red (`TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'edges')`). The tool restored the file: blob after restore `0b24af0a` equals HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

<details><summary>Runs</summary>

Branch commit `aa933de0`; head `0232fb5c` merges main `c385d903` (5 commits, none in either touched file).

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/select-affected-tests.test.ts --reporter=verbose` (on `aa933de0`): `Tests 70 passed (70)`; `pnpm --dir ui exec eslint` on both files: exit 0, `Duration 9.42s` (was 14.00 s for the live-tree block alone).
- On the merged head, `select-affected-tests.test.ts` plus `select-affected-tests-wiring.test.ts`: `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 80 passed (80)`; the walker test read 4837 ms.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (under the verify lock): `Test Files 170 passed | 2 skipped (172)`, `Tests 5029 passed | 2 skipped (5031)`.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 20 derived commands, each run, every exit 0. `--ran`: 20 derived, 20 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED.
- `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`: exit 0. `pnpm --dir ui run check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations, exit 0.
- Examples census: `git grep -l select-affected-tests` over `ui/examples/**/test/**` and `ui/e2e/**`: 0 files.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- What is left of each repeated call (about 0.8–1.0 s) is outside the scan: the `selected` count at the end of `selectAffectedTests` (lower-casing every filter for every test file, about 0.42 s a call) and the `placed` filter (`owningPackage` per test file, about 0.32 s). Both also run once in CI's real selector step. Not changed here.
- #31914 (devx seat 2) also edits `ui/scripts/select-affected-tests.mjs`; whichever lands second merges `main`.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (Publishes nothing: `ui/scripts/` is in no package; `skip-changeset`.)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
